params.body:
## What changes

A Car-Pass Vehicle History Report is valid for six months. Seven days before it expires the vehicle enters the Car-Pass work list; "km stand OK" takes it out; when the six months are over the daily task (`stocklist:daily`, `Daily::doUpdateOldCarpasses`) renews the report with the mileage on the sheet.

Until now the "checked" flag (`vehicles.carpass_data_checked`) was set by "km stand OK" and never reset, so a vehicle entered the work list once in its life and every later renewal went out without anyone looking at the mileage (finding X-05).

Decision by Ilse on 2026-09-17, option A: the renewal stays automatic after the window, with the sheet's mileage, and the vehicle must come back into the work list at every expiry.

- `CarpassController::handleVhrResult`: when a new report lands on the vehicle (`publicUrl` received), `carpass_data_checked` goes back to 0 together with `carpass_init` and `carpass_id`. A new report starts a new six-month cycle; the flag belongs to the cycle it was set in. This holds for the daily renewal and for a renewal the dealer requests by hand. A renewal that does not deliver a report (ISSUE, ERROR, pending) leaves the flag as it was.
- `Daily::doUpdateOldCarpasses` is public (same name, same body) so a test can run the Car-Pass step without the whole daily chain and without `Outbound::allowed()`.
- No migration: the existing flag is enough once it is reset at the right moment.

## Tests

New `tests/Feature/CarpassRenewalCycleTest.php` (`@rule S3-5.1, P1-2.7`), with the clock (`Carbon::setTestNow`) and Car-Pass faked (`Http::fake`, `Sleep::fake`):

- one vehicle over three cycles: fresh report is not work; in the list seven days before the expiry; "km stand OK" takes it out; the daily task sends nothing before the six months are over; at the expiry it renews with the sheet's mileage (120000), the new report is on the vehicle, the flag is 0, the vehicle is not work; six months minus seven days later it is back in the list; confirmed, renewed, back again the cycle after (six Car-Pass calls for two renewals);
- a manual renewal inside the window also resets the flag;
- a refused renewal keeps the flag.

Checked that the walk fails on `origin/main` (two failures) and passes with the change.

Ran: `CarpassRenewalCycleTest`, and `--filter 'Carpass|Worklist|ScheduleTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest|CompiledViewsTest|RowActionsOwnership|DealerHasOpenWorklist'`: OK (126 tests, 595 assertions).

No hot files touched. Not touched: `docs/bedrijfsregels/13-s3-car-pass.md` and its findings (another agent is rewriting that chapter). The rule text below is for that agent to fold in.

## Rule text for the S3 chapter (to fold in)

R S3-5.1, soort `wet`, stand `klant`, beslist Ilse 2026-09-17 (optie A):

> Het Vehicle History Report is zes maanden geldig. Zeven dagen vóór het vervallen komt de wagen in de werklijst Car-Pass (niet verkocht, laatste geslaagde opvraging ouder dan zes maanden min zeven dagen, `carpass_data_checked` = 0); "km stand OK" (of het opslaan van de fiche in dat venster) zet de vlag en haalt de wagen uit de lijst voor de lopende cyclus. Na de zes maanden registreert de dagelijkse taak automatisch opnieuw met de kilometerstand zoals ze op de fiche staat, ook zonder bevestiging. Zodra een nieuw rapport op de wagen landt wordt `carpass_data_checked` teruggezet op 0, zodat de wagen bij ELKE vervaldatum opnieuw in de werklijst komt; tot 2026-09-17 werd de vlag nooit teruggezet en kwam een wagen maar één keer in zijn leven in de lijst.

Code: `Dealer::AlmostExpiredCarpasses`, `VehicleRepository::getDealerAlmostExpiredCarpasses`, `CarpassController::markAsOk`, `OwnStockService::finalizeEdit` (`carpassAlmostExpired`), `Daily::doUpdateOldCarpasses`, `VehicleRepository::getExpiredCarpasses`, `CarpassController::handleVhrResult` (reset). Test: `CarpassRenewalCycleTest`.

Finding X-05 (`bevindingen/2026-09-11-zeven-dagen-voor-het-vervallen-komt-de.md`): the work-list half ("the flag is never reset, so the vehicle comes only once") is `opgelost` with this PR (`opgelost: 2026-09-17`, `beslist: Ilse`). The other half ("the task renews without a confirmation, with the mileage as it stands") is by decision the intended behaviour (option A), not a defect; R S3-6.1 stays as it reads.
params.title: Car-Pass renewal: the vehicle re-enters the work list at every expiry
